contract_version.description: Fixed marker for this contract's shape (this schema, check-verdict.py's REQUIRED_KEYS, and SKILL.md's stated contract move together). Bump when the shape changes so a stale caller fails loud with a version-mismatch reason instead of a generic key-set mismatch.

pass.description: null is the attacker's documented can't-tell state (genuinely unable to determine pass/fail) -- distinct from omitting the field, and rejected by check-verdict.py rather than treated as a guessed value.

checked.description: At least one claim actually re-checked against primary evidence, required even on a clean pass with an empty findings[] — closes the vacuous-accept case where pass:true/findings:[] is schema-valid but shows no independent verification work.
